critique: The 2s frame now reads much more clearly as a fiery particle burst: it has many orange radial streams and a denser central launch area than prior iterations. However, the trails still resolve as separated bead-like ember clumps rather than continuous flame streaks. Gravity pulls most of the explosion into a heavy downward fan, leaving the upper half thin and breaking the compact radial explosive silhouette. The 0.08s ignition remains a very small isolated dot, and the overall fire lacks a stronger hot yellow-white core and bloom characteristic of the Fire Trails 1 thumbnail.

suggestions.why: Reduce the strong downward ballistic bias so the burst retains a more compact, radial explosive form instead of collapsing into a lower-half fan by 2 seconds.
Increase secondary-particle emission along the parent motion so the orange paths join into continuous fire trails rather than sparse dotted clumps.
Slightly enlarge the secondary fire particles to give each denser trail a more cohesive flame body and a stronger early ignition presence.
Increase glow opacity to restore a hotter luminous fire core and reduce the dry ember-only appearance.
